purpose: Bounded 1С connector runtime over the proven durable authority: heartbeat, durable command jobs, one-active-lease delivery, ACK, bounded result/failure reporting, reconciliation and dead-letter handling; no provider traffic or production activation.
requiredInvariants: All machine routes authenticate the persisted rotating bearer and derive tenant, organization, installation, connection and credential scope server-side.
Heartbeat accepts only bounded health and diagnostic codes; free text, platform scope and secrets are not accepted or persisted.
Each durable job is bound to the canonical protocol command, normalized payload hash, organization, connection, credential allow-list and one canonical outbox fact.
At most one live lease exists per job; lease plaintext is returned once, only a salted verifier is persisted, and ACK/report operations require the exact current lease.
ACK and exact terminal reports are durably idempotent while conflicting replay fails closed.
Ambiguous delivery, lease expiry and unknown external effect enter reconciliation and are never blindly requeued.
Business rejection, confirmed result, bounded retry and dead-letter transitions are explicit, audited and database-enforced.
Human reconciliation requires database-proven accountant capability and fresh MFA; no HTTP route accepts arbitrary SQL, RPC or procedure names.
The existing connector authority remains PostgreSQL-authoritative under FORCE RLS; ordinary application roles receive only bounded function execution.
Events and mappings remain closed; no direct 1С database access, provider traffic, real data, production credential, production deployment or certification claim is introduced.
Migration changes remain forward-only and no new mandatory recurring cost is introduced.
